title: #418 Necessary Education
prompt: What is your opinion on the necessity of college education for success in life?

promptSegments.text: What is your opinion on the necessity of college education for success in life?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: College education helps people find better jobs.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: College education helps people find better jobs.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Getting a college degree helps people feel more certain about their future.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Getting a college degree helps people feel more certain about their future.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that college education is not the only path to success, focusing on the value of practical skills and on-the-job training.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that college education is not the only path to success, focusing on the value of practical skills and on-the-job training.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay emphasizes that specific, practical training and work experience are often more valuable for finding a job than academic degrees.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay emphasizes that specific, practical training and work experience are often more valuable for finding a job than academic degrees.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first main point is that college education gives specialized knowledge, which is essential for securing specific jobs and earning better money.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first main point is that college education gives specialized knowledge, which is essential for securing specific jobs and earning better money.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Secondly, college helps individuals build a professional network and improve general skills through exposure to diverse people and ideas.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Secondly, college helps individuals build a professional network and improve general skills through exposure to diverse people and ideas.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that practical skills and real-world experience are more valuable than academic degrees for success.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that practical skills and real-world experience are more valuable than academic degrees for success.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay argues that personal networking and connections are crucial for finding job opportunities, which is often overlooked by focusing only on education.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that personal networking and connections are crucial for finding job opportunities, which is often overlooked by focusing only on education.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
